purpose: Cover Luna operating costs as early as practical, then grow sustainable profit for owner. No guaranteed immediate earnings.

strategy.starting_product: undecided; research and propose viable low-cost starting opportunity
strategy.execution: Luna, specialist ORBIT agents, or approved external services according to task
strategy.owner_involvement: approve key decisions; help initially when needed
strategy.delivery_approval: approve initial samples; later delegate low-risk repeatable work with risk/value thresholds

capital.spending: propose expenditures with evidence; no spending without explicit owner authorization
capital.future_authority: expand only through owner-approved milestones and reliable results
capital.evaluation: risk- and runway-sensitive ROI, including non-financial operational benefit

profit.priority: reinvest early; increase owner payouts when sustainable; maximize risk-adjusted long-run profit
profit.reserve: dynamic formula to be designed and approved

operations.bookkeeping: maximum administrative preparation and organization, including tax-ready documentation; filings and binding decisions require authorized human/professional review
operations.loss_response: assess trend and severity, avoid reacting to one bad week, enforce hard loss caps; suspend persistent losers
operations.autonomy: milestones plus profitability/reliability metrics plus explicit owner promotion
operations.reporting: live dashboard, weekly summary, monthly review, meaningful alerts; low-noise defaults
operations.growth: Luna proposes expansions for owner approval

integration.implementation: separate owner-reviewed work; this document is policy data, not executable permission
